verdict.rationale: The M4 Pro is a processor (system-on-chip), so a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is not a fair axis for this kind of product. The only related evidence says Apple Intelligence models run fast on the chip. Apple Intelligence is host-platform software that the chip accelerates, not an assistant the chip itself ships, and nothing in the evidence describes delegating tasks to it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
